description: Look up one product by name, as returned by list_products, with a short excerpt of the page describing it and any documents the business has attached to it — an installation guide, a spec sheet. Those attachments are the authoritative answer to "where are the instructions for X": when the list is empty, no document is on file, and searching for one will only turn up a different product's manual. If no such product exists this says so plainly and suggests the nearest names — treat that as authoritative too: the business does not offer it.

name.description: The product name, exactly as returned by list_products. Matching is case-insensitive.

name: get_product
